note: Which books exist and whose they are. Each book's data lives in books/data/<id>.json, written by /books/import/. A book with no file yet shows as 'not trading yet'.

live.note: Live marks on open positions (js/books-live.js). endpoint: the deployed apps-script/QuotesCode.gs /exec URL; empty turns live marks off. yahoo: symbol overrides, IBKR symbol -> Yahoo ticker, for anything mapped wrongly.

publish.note: The Publish button on /books/import/. endpoint: the deployed apps-script/PublishCode.gs /exec URL; empty means heads download the file for the web team instead.

paused.note: Desks taken off The Floor for now. The site ignores this. To bring one back, move it into "desks".
